title: Task
description: Declared values only. Timestamps, CI results and the traffic light are measured and derived by scripts/build_state.py; a task file that declares them is rejected.

role.description: Names a folder of the derived views, so it is restricted.

type.description: tests-only and refactor skip the red-first check.

owner.description: Default agent. A human task needs no branch and may go from pending to done.

difficulty.description: An estimate: 1 = trivial, 5 = very hard or uncertain.
